diagnosis.summary: The IR checks if volume dropped (v1 - v2 >= 20), but the candidate checks if volume rose (v2 - v1 >= 20). Evidence F2 shows an extra action because the condition logic was inverted.
diagnosis.change_summary: Corrected the arithmetic expression from (v2 - v1) to (v1 - v2) to match the IR's requirement that the initial volume must be at least 20 units higher than the later volume.
